in-scope.item: Public renderer view that loads FormVersion.DefinitionJSON and renders theme/pages/components.
Canvas/profile fidelity: render at authored canvas dimensions (no responsive reflow).
Registry-driven rendering using the existing Builder Component Registry (no duplication).
Runtime rule effects from Story 3.7 (visible/enabled/required) applied live during entry.
Client-side field state + required validation UX + validation message area.
Safe fallback UI for unknown component types or malformed component props/config (do not crash).

out-of-scope.item: Submission transport / offline outbox / async sync pipeline (Story 3.10).
Responsive reflow into other device profiles; renderer must match authored profile.
Multi-profile rendering from one definition; separate designs/profiles are required per canvas.

dependencies.dependency: Story 3.7 (Runtime rule evaluation engine and parity runtime view)

storage.note: Renderer must treat DefinitionJSON as authoritative; no builder-only assumptions.

current-internal-parity-route.note: Story 3.7 parity-only renderer; Story 3.8 introduces the public/optimized renderer.

runtime-view.note: Currently contains type-based rendering; Story 3.8 should refactor to use registry-driven runtime rendering.

component-registry.note: Story 3.8 must reuse this registry for runtime rendering (no duplicated mapping).

unknown-component-fallback.rule: Unknown component type must render a stable fallback UI and never crash the renderer.

logic-engine.note: Renderer must apply computed visible/enabled/required state live during entry (parity with builder preview).

authenticated-active-version.note: Currently requires auth; public renderer may need a public/token-gated equivalent for unauthenticated access.

publishing.note: Published versions become active; renderer should load the active/published version for runtime.

design-fidelity-constraints.rule: Renderer must respect authored canvasSettings dimensions.
Scaling-to-fit viewport is allowed only as visual scaling; layout coordinates remain authored.

validation-ux.rule: Required validation applies only to visible + required components.
Validation messages must render in the reserved validation message area.
Submission transport is deferred; submit interaction should only validate + build payload in memory.
